messages:
maria: Heads-up — rolling schema migration for shipments table tonight at 00:30 UTC (maintenance window). DeployBot will run migration mig_2026_03_23_01 and kick off the chunked backfill. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026/03/mig-shipment-index. Please pin API to v2.14.3 for the window and hold canary to us-east-1 only. Expect ~150M rows; backfill runs in 30m chunks.

deploy-bot: DeployBot: migration mig_2026_03_23_01 scheduled for 00:30 UTC. Canary target: us-east-1, 1 instance. To abort: /deploy abort mig_2026_03_23_01.

jamal: Quick Q — what are our abort/rollback criteria? need clear SLO triggers we can watch in console.

maria: Good call. Abort if any of:
- lock contention (pg_locks count) sustained > 500 for >2m
- replica lag > 30s
- 95th read latency > 1s for >3m
- backfill error rate > 0.5% for 10m
If triggered, deploy-bot will attempt automatic rollback; otherwise SRE will escalate.

anna: Ops playbook summary:
1) Pin API to v2.14.3 in release console (route all traffic to pinned tag).
2) Flip feature flag db_mig_new_index=false to prevent new traffic paths.
3) Start canary (5m soak) -> check replication lag <5s, 95th latency stable.
4) If canary OK, release to rest of fleet and start backfill with throttle=50 rows/s per worker.
5) Monitor DB locks and CPU; we will stagger workers across AZs.

sre-ops: We'll add a circuit-breaker to the deployment that watches the above thresholds. Manual abort steps (if auto-rollback fails):

```
# manual abort
/deploy rollback mig_2026_03_23_01
# revert API pin
RELEASE_CONSOLE -> unpin v2.14.3 (or switch to previous pinned version)
# pause backfill workers
kubectl scale deployment backfill-worker --replicas=0 -n prod
```

carol: Also recommend a traffic routing fallback: if latencies spike, route write-heavy tenants to the write-proxy pool with lower QPS and keep read replicas for heavy reads. I can patch the routing rule: /routing set tenant-tier=limited for the 30m window.

maria: Added one more guard — we'll disable autovacuum on the affected partitions during the chunk write and re-enable after each chunk to avoid compaction stalls. Ops will run a quick analyze after chunk completion.

jamal: LGTMs on thresholds and manual steps. I'll be on pager during the window. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: DeployBot: migration mig_2026_03_23_01 entered PREP phase. Canary scheduled at 00:30 UTC. Notifying oncall.

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll post final go/no-go 15m before the window and drop the short checklist here.
